notes: Two things. Connect Claude: a new button that sets a project up for Claude Code in one click and one pasted sentence, so Claude knows how the board works and /stasys-audit and /stasys-fix run on your computer. And a project can now live anywhere on your drive: + New project opens the ordinary Windows folder window, and the folder you pick is the project - a folder that is already a Stasys project keeps its board exactly as it is.
